#### What is Framer 3.0?

Framer 3.0 is the June 16, 2026 release of the Framer website builder. It introduced AI agents that work inside the design canvas, branching for reviewing changes before publishing, a new creator Community, and AI credits to meter agent usage. It ranked #1 on Product Hunt the day it launched.

#### What can Framer AI agents do?

Per Framer, agents can generate pages from scratch and from screenshots, build responsive layouts, apply styling and interactions, create components, write custom code, manage CMS content, and audit a site for broken links, accessibility issues, and styling inconsistencies, all inside a live project.

## Why choose Framer for AI web design?

### Design with AI on a visual canvas

Use the visual canvas as the place where AI suggestions become real edits. Designers can review each change, adjust the details, and keep ownership over layout, messaging, and visual direction with confidence.

### Collaborate with AI agents

Ask AI agents to improve live pages by rewriting copy, tightening sections, updating CMS content, adjusting styling, reviewing accessibility, and resolving site issues while the team stays in control throughout.

### Publish without engineering handoff [...] ### Publish without engineering handoff

Framer connects AI-assisted site improvement with managed hosting, SEO tools, analytics insights, collaboration, and publishing, so teams can keep shipped websites accurate and useful over time with less handoff.

## Why teams use AI agents in Framer

Framer AI agents interface

### Canvas-native AI

Agent edits stay visible and editable on the Framer canvas, so designers and marketers can approve, refine, or undo changes instead of accepting AI output disconnected from the page.

SEO page settings in Framer

### SEO and AEO support

Framer supports metadata, structured content, indexing, analytics insights, and answer-focused improvements that help teams clarify what visitors and search engines need next.

### What I Dislike

❌ Copywriting generated by AI needs heavy editing  
❌ SEO features are basic out of the box  
❌ Not ideal for large-scale content sites  
❌ You’ll need design sense to make your site stand out  
❌ Lacks plugins or integrations for advanced use cases
